exercise: Actual author-visible installed-client use; no holdout, comparative benefit study, supplied expected output, browsing, delegation, dependency installation, source inspection or external action.
outcome: Completed portfolio/experiment/sensitivity calculations, explicit new notebook construction, observed command evidence, no-write preview inspection, explicit apply and current/stale readbacks, dependent reconsideration and final brief.
count_interpretation: Counts are exact target subprocesses in command-trace.json. Setup/guidance/package reads and help are separated from calculations and notebook user operations. Repeated get readbacks are real usability overhead from reading current revisions before writes and inspecting writes afterward; these are not unique decisions or measured benefit. Host tool wrappers and capture-driver launches are not additional entries in this target-command trace.

observations.issue: record --help exposes KIND and STATUS as unrestricted strings without listing supported categories or the default proposed status.
observations.impact: Category discovery required inspecting an empty brief review; readback revealed the default status. This caused navigation overhead but no failed command.
observations.correction: Used brief current_counts for category names and actual note readback for status; did not inspect runtime source.

observations.issue: Calculator help describes PARAMETERS only as a JSON object.
observations.impact: Portfolio and experiment schema discovery depended on the allowed reference files.
observations.correction: Read the relevant references and passed JSON with exact argv arrays.

observations.issue: The full portfolio enumeration produced a long host display that was truncated.
observations.impact: A displayed transcript alone was insufficient to inspect every portfolio.
observations.correction: The complete stdout was already preserved in command-trace.json and portfolio-output.json; downstream reading used the current-run saved output.

observations.issue: Evidence clarification invalidated seven dependent notes plus the original evidence even though numeric assumptions were unchanged.
observations.impact: Explicit reconsideration and fresh dependency links were required; the tool did not silently restore them.
observations.correction: Read all current/stale notes and recorded reconsidered portfolio conclusions, alternatives, effects, reversal condition and recommendation.

observations.issue: No independent finite-model experiment observation is available.
observations.impact: Cannot perform a legitimate result-conditioned belief update or claim arithmetic acceptance from CLI success.
observations.correction: Kept the experiment prospective, retained the original prior and separately recorded observed notebook outcomes.
